senses.sense_definition: A character used in computing to represent one or more unknown characters in a string or file name.

examples.text: You can use a <w>wildcard</w> to search for all files that end with the same extension.
The asterisk is a common <w>wildcard</w> used to match any sequence of characters.

senses.sense_definition: A person or thing that is unpredictable and can significantly affect the outcome of a situation.

examples.text: The new candidate is a total <w>wildcard</w> in this election.
Weather conditions remain a <w>wildcard</w> for the outdoor event.

senses.sense_definition: A player or team that enters a competition through a special invitation or qualifying spot, rather than standard qualification.

examples.text: The young athlete received a <w>wildcard</w> entry into the professional tournament.
As a <w>wildcard</w>, she surprised everyone by reaching the final round.

senses.sense_definition: To use a special character to allow a search or pattern to match multiple variations.

examples.text: You should <w>wildcard</w> the search term to include all plural forms.
The system failed because the input field was not <w>wildcarded</w> correctly.
